name: Montebalito, S.A.
summary: Montebalito, S.A. engages in real estate and renewable energy businesses in Sweden and internationally. It develops and rents properties; and provides land management services. The company also develops and manages photovoltaic parks. Montebalito, S.A. was founded in 1972 and is based in Madrid, Spain. The company is a subsidiary of Metambiente, S.A.
